selectedTechnicalArtifact.changeBoundary: PR #229 is merged to candidate-base/v0.2.5. Follow-up PR #231 changes only Cargo.toml and Cargo.lock to configure BDK with default features disabled and the std feature enabled.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.localEvidence: Exact PR #231 candidate check passed; 17 tests passed; clippy, documentation, and package validation passed. Exact dependency checks show the legacy Electrum TLS path and unused Sled/crossbeam-epoch path absent. cargo fmt --check exposes historical unrelated drift, not a change introduced by PR #231.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.hostedEvidence: PR #231 is ready for review. Nexus PR #177 was evaluated at its exact head against an equivalent std-only Core overlay; Nexus has no direct BDK dependency and did not re-enable BDK features. Residual audit findings remain separate owner work.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.immediateDecision: For v0.2 maintenance, Core uses BDK with default-features = false and features = [std]; Core enables no networking or persistence drivers.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.strategicDecision: Core owns transport-neutral capability and provenance contracts; opt-in Electrum, Esplora, RPC, light-client, and indexer backends remain outside Core in Gateway/backend or other owning adapter layers.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.proofBoundary: TLS authenticates transport, while chain-proof validation establishes state. Remote observations must not be labeled verified unless the applicable proof policy succeeds.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.scopeBoundary: The decision preserves offline and non-custodial behavior and existing multi-chain protocol/adapter surfaces; it does not establish production-complete universal blockchain support.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.releaseGates: PR #231 review, final immutable Core SHA, exact Nexus repin and downstream validation, release approval, and separate residual-audit disposition remain outstanding.
selectedTechnicalArtifact.nonClaim: The evidence does not establish release approval, publication, Nexus acceptance, license/admin resolution, production readiness, universal blockchain support, or resolution of residual audit findings.
